title: FY 2027 President's Budget - Commodity Futures Trading Commission
summary: The CFTC has submitted its FY 2027 budget request of $410.0 million and 650 full-time equivalents, representing a $45 million (12.3%) increase over the FY 2026 enacted budget. The budget document outlines the agency's funding needs to regulate U.S. futures, swaps, and options markets amid rapid technological innovation including blockchain, crypto assets, and AI-driven trading systems. The source is a budget justification document rather than a market structure analysis, and provides no direct market impact assessments or trading framework modifications.
